resumos: Provides pretrained models for generating sentence embeddings suitable for semantic search.
High-level library around Hugging Face models for generating semantic embeddings; offers multilingual models like paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 suitable for Portuguese and English.
Framework for generating semantic embeddings from text
Python library to compute dense embeddings from text using transformer models for semantic search.
